description: Verify a UI change matches the stated intent. Returns a verdict (pass, expected_change_detected, unexpected_regression, no_change_detected, or needs_human_review), a next_action, and a review_url. Requires a SnapDiff project and a stored page baseline.

after.description: URL of the page after the change.

full_page.description: Whether to capture the full page instead of the viewport.

ignore_selectors.description: CSS selectors for elements to ignore in the comparison.

intent.description: Description of the intended UI change.

intent_regions.description: Regions where the intended change is expected.

page_name.description: Name of the page with a stored baseline.

name: snapdiff_verify_ui_change
